name: example
_doc: Annotated reference config — every field the bench understands, with its default.
Copy this, delete what you don't need. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
A LEG = one (model × launch switches × request tunables) combination. Legs run in
order against the same book and the same features, so they are comparable.
_band: Which standing question this config answers — the real configs are the two bands, gpu.json and cpu.json. Cosmetic label in summaries + used for the run-hint commands.
_baselineRefs: Leg ids from ANOTHER band shown as comparison rows, recalled from stored results and NEVER run by this config (e.g. cpu.json lists the GPU baseline). Default [].
_book: Project id to activate first. Omit or "" to use whatever project is already open. The book actually measured is stamped into every result; a later run against a different book gets a ⚠ on recalled rows.
_features: Which app features to exercise. Validated at run time against window.__jwBench.features().
_repeats: Samples per feature per leg. 1 is not a measurement — this workload carries ~±10% run-to-run noise. Default 2.
_timeoutMinutes: Per feature RUN. A hit timeout is recorded as a finding, not a crash. Default 10.
_sweepChapterCap: entitySweep runs once per chapter — this caps how many. Default 3.
_ensureIndex: Build the RAG index first if missing. Without it, chat/characterChat silently run in bible-only mode, which is a DIFFERENT prompt. Default true.
_presetName: The engine preset the bench writes each leg's tunables into. It stays in the DB and is visible on the AI page. Default "Bench".
_featureArgs: Per-feature run args. Merged with per-leg featureArgs (leg wins).

chat.question: What is this book about, and who is the protagonist?

characterChat.question: What do you want most right now?

legs._id: Required, unique. Names the results subfolder.
legs.label: Human-readable — shows up in summary.md
legs._model: Required. A CATALOG model id (the same id the app's model list shows), NOT a file path.
legs._gguf: Optional explicit .gguf path for llama-bench. Empty → auto-resolved from the HF cache beside the engine.
legs._quant: Optional quant substring to disambiguate when a repo ships several (e.g. "Q4_K_XL").
legs._tunables: REQUEST params — written into the Bench preset. This is the one-source model: the preset owns the model + every tunable.
legs._launch: ENGINE switches for this leg's model load. Sent EPHEMERALLY on POST /v1/llm-runner/load — never saved, so your tune rows are untouched. Named fields map 1:1 to LoadRequest; anything else goes in `switches`.
legs._llamaBench: Raw engine matrix for this leg, or false to skip it. p = prompt sizes, n = tokens generated, reps = llama-bench's own repeats.
legs._overrides: Any of these override the run-level value for this leg only.
